definitions.explanation: The measured size of something, including length, width, and height.
A plan or way of doing something (often in the expression 寸法通り).

examples.japanese: ⟦{家具|かぐ}→家具：12314_kagu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{寸法|すんぽう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{測|はか}って→測る：01977_hakaru⟧⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please measure the dimensions of the furniture.

examples.japanese: {寸法|すんぽう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{合|あ}わなくて→合う：10466_au⟧、⟦{棚|たな}→棚：01650_tana⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{入|はい}らなかった→入る：00494_hairu⟧。
examples.english: The dimensions didn't match, so it didn't fit on the shelf.

examples.japanese: {寸法|すんぽう}⟦{通|どお}り→通り：01475_toori⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{作|つく}った→作る：00481_tsukuru⟧⟦のに→のに：10529_noni⟧、⟦なぜか→何故か：15645_nazeka⟧⟦{合|あ}わない→合う：10466_au⟧。
examples.english: Even though I made it according to the measurements, it somehow doesn't fit.
examples.notes: {寸法|すんぽう}⟦{通|どお}り→通り：01475_toori⟧ = according to the measurements

examples.japanese: ⟦うまい→うまい：01279_umai⟧{寸法|すんぽう}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{物事|ものごと}→物事：00291_monogoto⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{進|すす}める→進める：01949_susumeru⟧。
examples.english: To proceed with things according to a good plan.
examples.notes: Figurative: {寸法|すんぽう} used for plan/scheme

examples.japanese: ⟦その→その：00993_sono⟧{寸法|すんぽう}⟦なら→なら：09575_nara⟧⟦うまくいく→上手くいく：21787_umakuiku⟧⟦だろう→だろう：09576_darou⟧。
examples.english: With that plan, it should go well.

examples.japanese: ⟦{思|おも}い{通|どお}り→思い通り：25845_omoidoori⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{寸法|すんぽう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦いかなくて→行く：00119_iku⟧、⟦やり{直|なお}す→やり直す：03172_yarinaosu⟧⟦こと→こと：01164_koto⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なった→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: It didn't go according to plan, so I had to redo it.

notes:
{寸法|すんぽう} refers to measurements or dimensions, especially for clothing, furniture, or construction. The word comes from ⟦{寸|すん}→寸：noentry⟧ (an old unit of measurement) and ⟦{法|ほう}→法：13620_hou⟧ (method).

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {寸法|すんぽう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{測|はか}る→測る：01977_hakaru⟧: to take measurements
- {寸法|すんぽう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{合|あ}う→合う：10466_au⟧: measurements match
- {寸法|すんぽう}⟦{通|どお}り→通り：01475_toori⟧: according to measurements
- ⟦{採寸|さいすん}→採寸：19260_saisun⟧: taking body measurements

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦サイズ→サイズ：01363_saizu⟧: size (loanword)
- ⟦{大|おお}きさ→大きさ：10969_ookisa⟧: size (general)
- ⟦{長|なが}さ→長さ：05326_nagasa⟧/⟦{幅|はば}→幅：03565_haba⟧/⟦{高|たか}さ→高さ：05327_takasa⟧: length/width/height
